gloss: to enter, to get into, to slip into

definitions.explanation: To go into a place, often one that is not easily accessible or where one is not supposed to be.
To enter secretly or without permission.
To become immersed in something (figurative use).

examples.japanese: {猫|ねこ}が{狭|せま}い{隙間|すきま}に{入|はい}り{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: The cat got into the narrow gap.

examples.japanese: {不審者|ふしんしゃ}が{敷地|しきち}に{入|はい}り{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: A suspicious person entered the premises.

examples.japanese: {物語|ものがたり}の{世界|せかい}に{入|はい}り{込|こ}んで{夢中|むちゅう}になった。
examples.english: I got immersed in the world of the story.
examples.notes: [Note: Figurative use meaning to become absorbed]

examples.japanese: {虫|むし}が{部屋|へや}に{入|はい}り{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: A bug got into the room.

examples.japanese: {冷気|れいき}が{入|はい}り{込|こ}んでくる。
{砂|すな}が{靴|くつ}に{入|はい}り{込|こ}んだ。
{奥|おく}まで{入|はい}り{込|こ}んだ。
{泥棒|どろぼう}が{入|はい}り{込|こ}んだ。
スパイが{組織|そしき}に{入|はい}り{込|こ}んでいた。
examples.english: A spy had infiltrated the organization.

examples.japanese: {私有地|しゆうち}に{入|はい}り{込|こ}むな。
{記者|きしゃ}が{現場|げんば}に{入|はい}り{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: The reporter got into the scene.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}に{入|はい}り{込|こ}みすぎている。
{役|やく}に{入|はい}り{込|こ}む{俳優|はいゆう}。
examples.english: An actor who gets into character.

examples.japanese: {ゲーム|げーむ}の{世界|せかい}に{入|はい}り{込|こ}んでいる。
examples.english: I'm immersed in the game world.

examples.japanese: {話|はなし}に{入|はい}り{込|こ}んで{時間|じかん}を{忘|わす}れた。
examples.english: I got so into the conversation that I forgot the time.

notes:
{入|はい}り{込|こ}む is an intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}) meaning to enter or get into.

COMPOUND STRUCTURE:
- {入|はい}る (to enter) + {込|こ}む (deeply into) → to go deep into

ASPECT (ている):
{入|はい}り{込|こ}んでいる indicates a state of being inside or immersed.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {部屋|へや}に{入|はい}り{込|こ}む (get into a room)
- {隙間|すきま}に{入|はい}り{込|こ}む (get into a gap)
- {世界|せかい}に{入|はい}り{込|こ}む (get immersed in a world)
- {話|はなし}に{入|はい}り{込|こ}む (get into a conversation/story)

NUANCE:
Implies going deeper or more thoroughly than simple {入|はい}る. Often suggests entering somewhere one shouldn't be, or becoming deeply involved in something.

[Register: Neutral]
